meta.source: split6 fusion; causal s10/s5 smoothed score
meta.new_method: current score mid-rank among the immediately preceding 20 evaluated scores of the same subject
meta.decision: fixed rank>0.5; exact ties and the first 20 evaluated positions are negative
meta.controls: same OOF expanding rank; direct crossfit decision with identical negative warmup; steady-state metrics exclude the first 20 evaluated positions for every method
meta.transition_strata: post-hoc near switch <=5 versus >5 evaluated positions; descriptive only
meta.selection: single fixed rolling extension; no history-length, threshold, or test-OOF model selection
